name: Bhutan (1956–1969)
description: A field divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into yellow above and red below, with a white dragon (Druk) facing the hoist across the centre.
history: Second version of the national flag, introduced in 1956 for the visit of the third Druk Gyalpo, Jigme Dorji Wangchuck, to eastern Bhutan: based on photographs of the 1949 flag but with the dragon changed from green to white. Further changes, including the substitution of orange for red and the present 2:3 proportions, produced the current flag in 1969.
